scope: Complete independent mathematical, primary-source-scope and exact-code audit of all five B100 assertions.

per_label.label: lem:B-RD100-arc
per_label.reason: Independently checked the uniform choice e/p^3<A<e/p^2 with N not dividing A, every strict Newton gap and the b congruence, all intermediate and unbounded-tail terms, the exact Eisenstein degree, valuation survival after specialization, exact order p^3, and the logarithmic weight identity. The order-N field automorphism, possibly nonfaithful special action, exact cocycle fixing x^A, finite-level generic descent, absolute index e, and mu_p containment all rederive.

per_label.label: thm:B-RD100-ambiguity
per_label.reason: Checked the primitive constant cyclic subgroup, its actual good-model finite-flat closure and quotient, crystalline determinant and finite twist, exact multiplication snake sequence, and compatible Kummer cocycle lift. The eigenvalue multisets and nonzero trace difference use only N not dividing A, so nonfaithful special actions are covered. One whole potentially good group and an explicitly filtered group are distinguished.

per_label.label: cor:B-RD100-threshold
per_label.reason: Re-derived the B76 strict mixed inequality at n=3 and v_p(e)=1, and checked that the new arc supplies every permitted existential index e>p^2. No existence over each prescribed field is inferred.

per_label.label: thm:B-RD100-exact
per_label.reason: Checked the actual p^3 lower example at e=2p(p-1), the explicit A=1 specialization, determinant detection at actual p^4, dimension-zero/two reductions and residual filtered case, mixed exclusion e<p^4, and the B64 actual-target recurrence 1,2p-1,2p^2-1,2p^3-1 with surplus 2p-1 above a/(p-1). No source-thickness transfer is used. The manuscript index conversion gives exactly nu_min(p,2p(p-1),2)=3.

per_label.label: rem:B-RD100-scope
per_label.reason: Checked the existential versus fixed-field distinction, unrestricted positive v_p(e) construction versus valuation-one threshold, the restricted exact-index family, all finite certificate counts, and the separation of arithmetic checks from formal-group/descent/quotient/Kummer effectivity.

fresh_original_opening.title: Hopkins and Gross (1994), Equivariant vector bundles on the Lubin--Tate moduli space
fresh_original_opening.actually_read: Complete original equations (5.3)--(5.8), Proposition 5.7 statement and coefficient congruence; equations (12.1)--(12.9), Proposition 12.10 and its entire printed proof through the final square, including arbitrary residue-field extension. Also the complete displayed Proposition 4.2 proof was returned and read.
fresh_original_opening.scope: Proposition 5.7 attributes integrality to Hazewinkel; no fresh reading of that book is claimed. Original indexed text was read, without page-image inspection.

retained_original_rereading.scope: Original author text, Lemma 2.2.4 and Corollary 2.2.6 with their complete printed proofs, and Theorem 2.2.7 with its complete proof, pp.26--27. The determinant argument in the complete canonical B18 proof and all relevant B62 steps were independently reread.

source_audit.prior_source_dependencies: The established Tate/Bondarko source validations are reused through the complete canonical B64 coefficient/logarithm/Cartier-projection/actual-graph proof, which was read in full and rederived here. No fresh original Bondarko or Tate read is claimed.

retrieval_failures_retained.resolution: First-engine search recovered the indexed original; complete passages then opened successfully.

retrieval_failures_retained.error: URL not accessible through web tool
retrieval_failures_retained.resolution: Read the already retained original author text, explicitly without claiming a new web opening.

source_audit.read_completeness: An earlier oversized dependency read was truncated and not credited. The full B62, B64 and B76 files were subsequently actually read in bounded chunks; the final B100 candidate and checker were also each read completely in bounded chunks.

literal_isolated_rerun.scope: Unchanged finite symbolic/arithmetic certificate only; all infinite geometric and effectivity assertions are audited from the complete written proofs separately.

no_inference: No finite computation is used to prove existence/effectivity of an infinite formal group, Eisenstein DVR, descent, finite quotient or compatible Kummer extension; those conclusions were independently checked from their written proofs.
